vulnerability.name: CVE-2026-126190
vulnerability.description: Soup Sieve versions before 4.0.0 can exhibit polynomial-time denial of service while matching descendant combinators against deeply nested attacker-influenced HTML or XML.

statements.status_notes: This finding is limited to the generated solution template's optional doc dependency group in both dash and no_ui Poetry lockfiles. Those locks resolve SoupSieve 2.10 for Python versions below 3.11.5. It does not describe the SAF CLI runtime dependencies. Assess generated solution products separately.

vulnerability.name: CVE-2026-126190
vulnerability.description: Soup Sieve versions before 4.0.0 can exhibit polynomial-time denial of service while matching descendant combinators against deeply nested attacker-influenced HTML or XML.

statements.status_notes: In the generated solution template's optional doc dependency group, Python 3.11.5 and later resolve SoupSieve 4.1, which is beyond the first patched version 4.0.0.

vulnerability.name: CVE-2026-126192
vulnerability.description: Soup Sieve versions before 2.10 can perform excessive work for certain :has() selectors containing the general sibling combinator.

statements.status_notes: The generated template lockfiles resolve SoupSieve 2.10 for Python below 3.11.5 and 4.1 from Python 3.11.5 onward. Both are at or above the first patched version 2.10.
